status: Three-view prototype ready for parent review; leaf shell needs volume refinement; not approved or promoted

reviewed_files.observed: Warm amber eyes and approved face proportion remain readable. Leaf surfaces are too close to the shell; front silhouette reads as a continuous green dome.
Leaves visibly exist as separate closed meshes, but overlap shadow and edge thickness are weak. Lower leaves look broad and orderly compared with A4.
Full leaf-covered dome, small natural white blossom, legs and tail visible. Shallow leaf layering remains clear as the main shortcoming; no missing textures seen.

review_recommendation: Do not promote this c01 as final art. Next bounded iteration should increase individual leaf cross-section/rounded edges, introduce a small tip lift and clearer row separation, with shorter staggered leaves where necessary. Preserve the face and approved head/body proportions.
source_generation_issue_resolved: An initially over-high left brow failed surface attachment assertion; it was moved inward without changing head geometry before any final render.
